title: resource-manifest
description: One line of a ticket's resource manifest (<manifest-dir>/<ticket>.jsonl), one branch per shape. A human and tool mirror of the loader's exact key set per shape; the crate does not interpret this file, and a test pins each branch's required set to the loader's. A line is at most 4096 bytes including its newline. Every line's ticket equals the file's ticket; paths are stored resolved and must resolve inside one of the ticket's roots.

oneOf.title: root
oneOf.description: Written only by init, only before any other line: one of the ticket's roots (the fence every path entry must resolve inside).

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value.

path.description: An absolute, existing directory, stored resolved. Never /.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value.

id.description: Stable entry id; unique among live entries.

oneOf.description: A process the ticket owns. pid_start_ms is the OS start time: it lets a later reader tell a reused pid from the recorded one.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value.

pid.description: An integer > 1: signalling 0, 1 or a negative would hit a group or init.

pid_start_ms.description: The process's OS start time in ms since the epoch, read by the writer (on Linux from /proc, otherwise the system ps); a pid whose start time cannot be read is refused.
